summary: ci_test.sh against private copies of tools/ci/report.sh and bisect.sh, each fault failing its rows

faults.name: report
faults.summary: an unfinished run bisected as a failure of the runner

lines: ci-test: failed: report core unfinished unfinished-core: the row fails

faults.name: comment
faults.summary: a failed comment on the issue not reported

edits.find: { echo "ci: bisect: the comment on #$issue failed" >&2; return 1; }
edits.replace: { echo "ci: bisect: the comment on #$issue failed" >&2; return 0; }

lines: ci-test: failed: bisect unfinished-core core 1 comment: the row fails

faults.name: label
faults.summary: a failed label on the issue not reported

edits.find: { echo "ci: bisect: the label on #$issue failed" >&2; status=1; }
edits.replace: { echo "ci: bisect: the label on #$issue failed" >&2; status=0; }

lines: ci-test: failed: bisect unfinished-core core 0 edit: the row fails

faults.name: intermittent
faults.summary: a failed comment on a failure that passed when run again not reported

edits.find: say "$on: $(short "$bad") passed $failed when run again, so the failure did not repeat. The issue is labelled intermittent and stays open; it loses the label when the failure comes back." || status=1
edits.replace: say "$on: $(short "$bad") passed $failed when run again, so the failure did not repeat. The issue is labelled intermittent and stays open; it loses the label when the failure comes back." || :
